skill.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
skill.description: Guide Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through Higgsfield product photoshoot jobs for studio, lifestyle, ad, carousel, hero, restyle, and virtual model images.
skill.summary: Guides product image generation through Higgsfield modes and submits jobs to GPT Image 2.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are Markdown mode names, option labels, or sample output and were dismissed as false positives. The confirmed risks are remote installer execution through curl piped to sh, intended Higgsfield CLI execution, and auto-upload of local product images to a backend service. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is executed through a shell pipe.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl piped to sh with a pinned package install, checksum verification, and explicit user confirmation before installation.

remediation.issue: CLI commands accept user-derived prompts and image paths.
remediation.suggestion: Validate mode, count, and aspect ratio values, quote arguments safely, and avoid shell interpolation for user-provided values.

remediation.issue: Local product images can be uploaded to a third-party backend.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the upload behavior, request consent for sensitive assets, and document data retention and access expectations.

content.value_statement: Teams need product visuals in many formats, but prompt setup can be slow and inconsistent. This skill guides mode selection and submits structured Higgsfield jobs for branded image outputs.
actual_capabilities: Selects a product photoshoot mode from studio, lifestyle, carousel, ad, hero, model, conceptual, and restyle options.
Asks up to four short questions to collect count, style, use case, and brand context.
Runs the Higgsfield product-photoshoot CLI with prompt, image, count, and aspect ratio inputs.
Supports local product images or existing upload IDs as references.
Returns hosted image URLs after generation completes.
Documents common mistakes and mode boundaries.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI and an authenticated Higgsfield account.
Uploads referenced product images to Higgsfield when local paths are used.
Does not expose or edit the backend-enhanced GPT Image 2 prompt.
Does not handle video, avatar, raw text-to-image, or marketplace card workflows.

output_examples.input: Requested Christmas restyle of an existing product image.

best_practices: Upload clear product photos when brand fidelity matters.
State the destination, such as Shopify, Instagram, Pinterest, paid ads, or website hero.
Confirm uploads are acceptable before using confidential or unreleased product images.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for videos, avatars, or raw text-to-image without a product.
Do not ask for more than four setup questions before generation.
Do not paste internal enhanced prompts into user-facing results.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates product-focused image jobs for studio shots, lifestyle scenes, ads, carousels, hero banners, restyles, and virtual model images.

faq.question: Does it need a product photo?
faq.answer: A product photo is preferred for better fidelity, but the skill can ask for a text description when no image is available.

faq.question: Does it upload local images?
faq.answer: Yes. Local image paths are uploaded to Higgsfield when used as references.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it choose the best mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps the user request to a mode such as product_shot, moodboard_pin, ad_creative_pack, or restyle.

faq.question: What does the final response include?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to return image URLs and avoid exposing internal prompts or job metadata.
